{{Short description|Canadian mathematics award}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=September 2026}}
The '''André Aisenstadt Prize''' recognizes a young [[Canada|Canadian]] mathematician's outstanding achievement in pure or applied mathematics.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.crmath.ca/en/prizes-and-honours/andre-aisenstadt-prize/|title=André Aisenstadt Prize|publisher=Centre de recherches mathématiques |accessdate= 7 June 2025}}</ref>

It has been awarded annually since 1992 (except in 1994, when no prize was given) by the [[Centre de Recherches Mathématiques]] at the [[University of Montreal]]. The prize consists of a $3,000 award and a medal. It is named after {{Interlanguage link|André Aisenstadt|fr}}.
